LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockTipControls: Left-drag to move.\nRight-click to jump to the void erosion origin.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_JumpOriginMissing: The erosion origin does not exist yet.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockPhaseDesc_0: The void still sleeps. Prepare to flee—or to stand against it.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockPhaseDesc_1: Void erosion has begun. Act before it is too late.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockPhaseDesc_2: The erosion spreads without fail. Each night, the beasts' voices twist a little more.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockPhaseDesc_3: The void is no longer rumor. Settlements vanish, roads break, and the sky changes color.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockPhaseDesc_4: Most of the world has been swallowed. What land remains holds its breath in the needle's shadow.
